$comment: Workers AI models wordsmith cloud offers Scribe (api/functions/api/scribe.js runs them, src/lib/scribe.svelte.js lists them). Each answers Scribe's prompt correctly with no hidden reasoning; 'options' and 'suffix' are what that model needs to skip reasoning (each model takes a different switch). 'input' and 'output' are Cloudflare's neurons per million tokens, used to count each user's daily allowance. Tested 2026-11-12 on Scribe's full prompt (neurons per request in each note): GLM-4.7 Flash, Llama 3.2 3B and Granite 4 micro got tickets wrong and are left out.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.note: Most accurate, about 7 neurons a request

models.name: Qwen3 30B
models.note: Cheapest, about 5; sometimes rewrites a whole ticket
